lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and holders of 5% or more have agreed not to sell or transfer shares for 180 days after the offering closes. Some exceptions apply.

what: Through its Hong Kong unit Oceanic Bounty, it builds custom software and sells smart office products such as lockers and booths.
proceeds: It plans to put about 30% toward hiring technical staff, 25% toward technology tools, and 20% toward its workspace products business. About 15% is for sales and expansion, and 10% for investments and general costs. Net proceeds are estimated at about $27.61 million.
risks: It may not keep growing as fast as before, and fast growth could strain its management, staff and systems.
Its market is crowded and easy to enter, so it may struggle to compete.
Harm to its reputation or brand could cost it clients and key employees.
If it fails to manage its cash well, it may need more money, which may not be available on good terms.
